intended_delta: Replace the invalid service-USB VBUS-to-nonexistent-module-pin path with a self-powered 100 k/100 k VBUS sense divider to ESP GPIO15; add 22 ohm D+/D- series resistors and DNP tuning capacitors; connect every USB-C VBUS, ground and shield contact; correct EN timing to 10 k/1 uF; and replace the incomplete four-pin UART header with direct GND, 3V3, TX, RX, EN and BOOT access

Intermediate clipped, cluttered and unmoved-caption screenshots are preserved as rejected evidence.
